sources.locator: pp3-7 and 9-12, nominal assembly and reference test conditions

requirements.description: Review complete host port, DC isolation, protection and antenna matching adaptation; nominal 50 ohm is not an omission justification.
Review actual enclosure, non-metal mounting, battery/metal clearance, cable direction and retention; manufacturer reference setup is not host fit evidence.
Qualify actual host feed, launches, returns, protection, cable and antenna interface with selected materials and frequency-dependent models.
Measure installed antenna match, radio sensitivity/radiated performance and coexistence across intended bands and operating states.
